title: Cut the File, Not the King
setup: Black's king is on h6 with two pawns running on c2 and e4, and your rooks sit on b3 and c1.
hint: Both black pawns are about to promote. Ignore them and take the file the king would use.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rg3}} seizes the g-file without check, and nothing Black plays stops what comes next. {{Rh1#}} mates down the h-file with the rook on g3 holding g6 and g7. Two pawns one step from queening are still slower than one rook on the right file.
